product.name: Snyk AI Trust Platform
product.description: An AI-integrated platform that automates and enhances application security testing and development workflows.

product.name: DeepCode AI Engine
product.description: An AI engine that uses curated security data models to detect and prioritize software vulnerabilities.

product.name: Snyk Code
product.description: A static application security testing tool that scans source code for vulnerabilities without impacting development speed.

product.name: Snyk Open Source
product.description: A software composition analysis tool that identifies vulnerabilities in open source dependencies using a comprehensive vulnerability database.

product.name: Snyk Container
product.description: A container and Kubernetes security tool that detects and prioritizes vulnerabilities throughout the software development lifecycle.

product.name: Snyk Infrastructure as Code
product.description: A tool that detects and fixes misconfigurations in cloud infrastructure code with inline remediation guidance.
